import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_df = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get column order from sample submission for consistent headers
submission_template = sample_df.columns.tolist()

# Map author strings to consistent numeric codes (matches predict_proba output)
author_codes = {author: idx for idx, author in enumerate(pd.unique(train_df["author"]))}

# Prepare training data (no test label mapping needed!)
texts = train_df["text"].fillna("")
labels = train_df["author_code"].values

X_texts = texts.values

# Split into train/holdout validation - NEVER refit on this split
np.random.seed(42)
indices = np.arange(len(labels))
n_val = int(0.2 * len(labels))
val_mask = np.random.choice(len(indices), n_val, replace=False)
val_idx = indices[val_mask]
train_idx = np.setdiff1d(indices, val_idx)

X_train = X_texts[train_idx]
y_train = labels[train_idx]
X_val = X_texts[val_idx]
y_val = labels[val_idx]

# Train classifier on ONLY train split (never touches validation data)
clf = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "tfidf",
            TfidfVectorizer(
                max_features=15000,
                ngram_range=(1, 2),
                min_df=2,
                max_df=0.95,
                sublinear_tf=True,
                token_pattern=r"(?u)\b\w+\b",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "classifier",
            LogisticRegression(
                C=1.0, penalty="l2", solver="lbfgs", max_iter=1000, n_jobs=-1
            ),
        ),
    ]
)
clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate on held-out set using CODES that match predict_proba
val_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val)
log_loss_val = log_loss(y_val, val_proba, labels=list(range(3)))
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {log_loss_val:.6f}")

# Predict on test set (unseen data - never used in training)
test_texts = test_df["text"].fillna("").values
test_proba = clf.predict_proba(test_texts)

# Scale so row sums equal 1 (as competition requires)
for i in range(len(test_proba)):
    if test_proba[i].sum() > 0:
        test_proba[i] /= test_proba[i].sum()

# Clamp to avoid log(0) issues per competition spec
eps = 1e-15
test_proba = np.clip(test_proba, eps, 1 - eps)

# Create submission dataframe in correct format
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": test_proba[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_proba[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_proba[:, 2],
    }
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final Validation Log Loss: {log_loss_val:.6f}")
